# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 platform release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings the Skia m152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, and runtime safety fixes. It adds asynchronous readback APIs, expands native package coverage, and fixes several ownership and rendering issues.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152 and servicing fixes incorporated** — Updates the bundled renderer through the m152 release and subsequent upstream stability fixes.

## API Surface

- **Graphite and asynchronous pixel readback APIs added** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels methods for images and surfaces.

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Native ownership issues corrected** — Fixes object lifetime problems affecting stream conversion, runtime-effect uniforms, region iteration, pixmap subsets, and raster image creation.

## Platform

- **Native package coverage expanded** — Adds Apple symbols, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and provides FreeType support for Nano Server.

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzzSharp shaping performance by avoiding an unnecessary feature-array copy.
